item: OSM daily update: tag-level change rows written with each applied file (v0.6.0 B2, S06-01 S2)
key_paths: src/osm/apply.py; src/osm/changes.py; src/osm/lane_models.py; tests/test_osm_tag_rows.py; tests/test_osm_apply.py; tests/test_osm_changes.py
summary: Each daily change file now writes one osm_tag_changes row per key added, removed or modified, stamped with the file's own timestamp and the object's version, in the same transaction as the object changes. A delete writes a removed row for every key it held; a created object writes every key as added; a stored object whose tags stop qualifying writes its real key changes. Nothing is written for an object outside the kept classes, in another country, older than the stored row, outside the border, or moved out of it; a modify of an object the lane did not hold writes none (its old tags are unknown) and is counted tags_unknown_before; a tag-neutral change is counted tags_unchanged; a missing version is stored NULL and counted version_absent. R428 adds two nullable columns to the existing table (country_alpha3, object_event: created, deleted or left_class) through the lane's additive path, no backfill. Four new counters in the per-file counts. No network, no new keys.
